name: Discovery
description: Find an evidence-backed target user, problem, opportunity, and positioning hypothesis before product commitment.

members.role: Entry-only fallback — assume steering after primary leader provider/runtime failure; never implement
Default — primary-source evidence, market and user research, uncertainty map
Default — alternatives, segment selection, positioning, and market test design
Default — user problem framing, product implications, and opportunity decision
Optional — exploratory journey or concept when behavior must be made concrete

entry_criteria: An opportunity, audience, or problem is important but materially uncertain
exit_criteria: A named decision can be made from cited evidence
residual uncertainty and next experiment are explicit
